headline: Norway Sovereign Wealth Fund Reports $31 Billion Third-Quarter Loss
summary: Norway's $2 trillion sovereign wealth fund posted a third-quarter loss of 278 billion kroner ($31 billion). The negative return was primarily caused by rising interest rates, which weighed on equity and fixed-income portfolio valuations.
why: Government Pension Fund Global is the world's largest sovereign fund, holding equity stakes in thousands of listed companies globally, making its performance a benchmark for global market movements.
